source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if NVMe RAID fail LED function works normally
1. Insert NVMe SSD into BP slot and create RAID 1
2. Unplug one NVMe SSD from RAID group
3. Check RAID fail LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Check system spec define LED function

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Generic Locate command plus visual RAID-fail LED confirmation.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: LED command result and physical observation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; acknowledges visual evidence but does not create RAID 1 or remove a member and substitutes Locate for failure indication.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds disposable members, destructive approval, physical removal, degraded evidence and separate recovery decision.

original_test_intent: On an isolated two-member NVMe RAID 1, physically remove the approved member and verify the specified chassis RAID-failure indicator while the controller reports the expected degraded state.
original_method: Create RAID 1 only on two serial-allowlisted disposable SSDs, verify a healthy synchronized baseline, have a qualified operator unplug the mapped member under the supported hot-remove procedure, then correlate visible Fail LED evidence with controller/OS/BMC degraded events.
manual_activity: The failure stimulus is physical unplugging and acceptance includes direct visual inspection of the RAID-fail LED. Automation can build/monitor the test array only after approval; it cannot complete or claim those core human actions.
required_inputs: Controller/firmware and RAID 1 support plus approved creation parameters
Two disposable SSD serials, chassis/enclosure slots and proof they contain no protected data
Hot-removal procedure and exact member to unplug
Backup, OOB, reinsertion/rebuild/disposal plan and expected degraded evidence
safety_requirements: Never create RAID on boot, mounted, in-use, protected, data-bearing or unidentified media.
Verify RAID 1 is healthy and member-to-bay mapping is exact before removal.
A person performs the supported physical unplug; do not simulate it with controller commands.
Locate LED is not a failure stimulus and must not replace the required fault path.
Do not reinsert, rebuild, initialize, delete or retry automatically after the observation.
agent_execution_scope: Capture pre-state and execute an approved controller-native RAID 1 build if explicitly authorized.
Verify synchronization/health and present the exact member/bay mapping to the operator.
Record controller, OS and BMC degradation events around the manual unplug and correlate operator media.
Leave the array in the documented safe state and report Tool Result without hardware verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve destructive RAID creation and the exact member-removal/recovery plan.
Physically unplug the approved SSD and visually attest the Fail LED.
Authorize any recovery/rebuild separately and assign the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Non-equivalent and incomplete: Locate neither creates RAID 1 nor produces member failure, and `/c0`/enclosure assumptions are unverified.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use controller-native commands for approved RAID 1 creation and read-only health monitoring; retain physical unplug and visual evidence as primary.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: RAID 1, one-member unplug, Fail LED inspection and 10/5-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a disposable-array manifest, stable serial-to-bay mapping, synchronized controller event capture and timestamped operator video of the exact fail indicator.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact NVMe RAID adapter, firmware, backplane and fail-LED wiring.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record controller/backplane/BMC firmware, OS driver and RAID utility versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform hot-remove and RAID-fail LED specifications plus controller degraded-array documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds destructive targeting and recovery gates without replacing the physical failure.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Disposable topology, fail truth table and recovery plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A degraded CLI state does not prove the physical LED; a visible LED alone does not prove the correct member failed.

project_override_considerations: The project may choose disposable members and controller parameters, but completion must include the real one-member removal and exact physical indicator unless the source is formally overridden.
expected_evidence: Approved SSD serial/bay map, pre-state absence of protected data and destructive approval
RAID 1 creation/synchronization transcript and healthy baseline
Operator-attributed removal timestamp and Fail LED photo/video
Matching degraded-member controller/OS/BMC events, post-state, recovery decision, Tool Result and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure's RAID 1 removal and Fail LED observation align with the specification-driven LED criterion. Missing parameters are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The test semantics are clear. It is ready when the project supplies disposable hardware, safe removal and LED/recovery definitions.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its Locate shortcut and restores RAID build plus real member removal.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains critical storage and recovery controls while applying MANUAL ONLY to the physical/visual acceptance path.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates automated degraded telemetry, manual fault/LED evidence and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a harmless locator operation from being reported as validation of a real degraded-array failure indicator.
independent_technical_reasoning: Both causal stimulus and accepted LED evidence are physical. Even if array creation and telemetry are automated, those human core steps determine the V3.1 class.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat removal, reinsert, rebuild, initialize or toggle alternate LEDs automatically. Preserve first-fault evidence and await owner instruction.
